resources.string: Keeps nearby phones connected so messages can be carried. No message content is shown.
Alerts for delivered messages. The alert never contains the message text.
Shows that a location-sharing session is active and offers a one-tap stop.
Status appears here when the runtime is connected.
This app needs nearby-device permission to find people around you. Denying it stops the mesh; you can change it in Android Settings at any time.

Carrying messages for other people uses the radio while the screen is off. Android and some vendors limit that. You decide whether to allow it; limiting it saves battery but stops relaying until you reopen the app.
If relaying stops with the screen off, open Android Settings, select Apps, select aoheyra, and check the battery optimisation entry after each OS update.
If relaying stops with the screen off, check Settings, Device care, Battery, Sleeping apps, and keep aoheyra out of the sleeping list if you want it to relay in the background.
If relaying stops with the screen off, check the app\'s Autostart and background-activity settings in the vendor\'s Security app, then reopen aoheyra.
Oppo and OnePlus: check background activity
If relaying stops with the screen off, check the app\'s background-activity and aggressive-battery settings in Settings, then reopen aoheyra.
If relaying stops with the screen off, look in Android Settings for background-data and battery restrictions for aoheyra. The exact menu depends on the device and Android version.
Vendor-specific steps for keeping the mesh running
Keeps the mesh running when the screen is off
